input.quote: (e) THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE IN LIEU OF ALL OTHER WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
input.rationale: Section 5 warrants only non-violation of law (knowledge-qualified), authority/rights and non-infringement, and Section 1(b) obliges Contractor to perform the Services in a professional and workmanlike manner. Nowhere does the Agreement warrant that software deliverables or the Services conform to their documentation or Specifications, and there is no warranty period and no repair, replacement or refund remedy; the implied warranties of merchantability and fitness are disclaimed, so Company is left with no conformance protection. That fails every material term of the fallback, so we insert the shortest fallback warranty: 90 days for software deliverables, 30 days for Services, with repair, replacement or refund. The existing disclaimer expressly preserves express warranties, so it needs no amendment.

ops.text: Contractor warrants that, for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, each software deliverable provided under a Statement of Work will conform in all material respects to its documentation and Specifications, and that, for a period of thirty (30) days following performance, the Services will conform to the requirements of the applicable Statement of Work. For any breach of this warranty, Contractor shall, at Company's election, repair or replace the non-conforming software deliverable or Services or refund the fees paid for them.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 5 contains no conformance warranty, no warranty period and no remedy, so we have added our fallback position: 90 days for software deliverables, 30 days for Services, with repair, replacement or refund. The existing disclaimer already preserves express warranties, so no other change is needed.
proposal.summary: Insert a conformance warranty with 90-day software / 30-day services periods and repair, replacement or refund remedies.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
